messages.subject: Re: how to download and run LCC200 module?
parts:
Hi Darren,

The government shut this link down about a year ago. Here is how you can get the file you need.

lcc05 <- reproducible::prepInputs(url = "https://drive.google.com/open?id=1pZoExaEDlm-TYmoUKvMq6h1AGTbsm71K", destinationPath = tempdir()) # destinationPath is the folder where you want to save the file once downloaded.

Let me know if you can't make it to work. :)

Bst,

Tati
